title: Liquiritin inhibits H(2) O(2) -induced oxidative stress injury in H9c2 cells via the AMPK/SIRT1/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Tang, Tong-Juan; Wang, Xiang; Wang, Liang; Chen, Ming; Cheng, Jing; Zuo, Meng-Yu; Gu, Jin-Fan; Ding, Rui; Zhou, Peng; Huang, Jin-Ling
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甘草苷通过AMPK/SIRT1/NF-kappaB通路抑制心肌细胞氧化应激损伤，仅涉及分子对接初步预测，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Heart failure (HF) is a serious disease with high mortality. Oxidative stress plays a vital role in its occurrence and development. Licorice is commonly used to treat HF in traditional Chinese medicine. Liquiritin, the main ingredient of licorice, has antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, but the mechanism against oxidative stress in cardiomyocytes has not been reported. Establishment of oxidative damage model in H9c2 cells by hydrogen peroxide (H(2) O(2) ). Liquiritin (5, 10, 20 mumol/L) could significantly prevent the loss of cell viability and decrease the apoptosis rate. It can reduce the levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS), malonedialdehyde (MDA), lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta), interleukin-6 (IL-6), and increase the activity of ATP, superoxidedismutase (SOD), glutathione peroxide (GSH-px), glutathione reductase (GR) and catalase (CAT) to alleviate oxidative stress and inflammation in a dose-dependent manner. Liquiritin was found to be related to AMP-Activated Protein Kinase (AMPK) pathway by molecular docking. Western blotting (WB) and quantitative reverse transcription PCR (RT-qPCR) confirmed that liquiritin could promote AMPKalpha phosphorylation and sirtuin 1 (SIRT1) protein expression, and inhibit phosphorylation of nuclear factor kappa B p65 (NF-kappaB p65). Compound C, EX 527, and PDTC can reverse the effects of liquiritin, indicating that its antioxidant effect is achieved by regulating AMPK/SIRT1/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. PRACTICAL APPLICATIONS: Heart failure is one of the most common cardiovascular diseases, and its treatment remains a worldwide problem. Licorice is a food and dietary supplement that has been used widely in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM). Liquiritin is one of the main active components of licorice, which has antioxidant and anti-inflammatory pharmacological effects. This study revealed the mechanism of licorice against oxidative damage of H9c2 cardiomyocytes, and provided a scientific basis for liquiritin as an antioxidant in the treatment of heart failure.
abstract_zh: 心力衰竭（HF）是一种死亡率高的严重疾病。氧化应激在其发生和发展中起着至关重要的作用。甘草在中医中常用于治疗心力衰竭。甘草苷是甘草的主要成分，具有抗氧化和抗炎特性，但其对抗心肌细胞氧化应激的机制尚未见报道。通过过氧化氢（H(2) O(2) ）建立H9c2细胞氧化损伤模型。甘草苷（5、10、20 μmol/L）能显著防止细胞活力丧失并降低凋亡率。它能降低活性氧（ROS）、丙二醛（MDA）、乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）、白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）、白细胞介素-6（IL-6）的水平，并增加ATP、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GSH-px）、谷胱甘肽还原酶（GR）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）的活性，以剂量依赖性方式减轻氧化应激和炎症。通过分子对接发现甘草苷与AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）通路相关。蛋白质印迹（WB）和定量逆转录PCR（RT-qPCR）证实，甘草苷能促进AMPKα磷酸化和去乙酰化酶1（SIRT1）蛋白表达，并抑制核因子κB p65（NF-κB p65）的磷酸化。Compound C、EX 527和PDTC能逆转甘草苷的作用，表明其抗氧化效应是通过调节AMPK/SIRT1/NF-κB信号通路实现的。实际应用：心力衰竭是最常见的心血管疾病之一，其治疗仍是全球性难题。甘草是一种食品和膳食补充剂，在中医中广泛使用。甘草苷是甘草的主要活性成分之一，具有抗氧化和抗炎药理作用。本研究揭示了甘草对抗H9c2心肌细胞氧化损伤的机制，为甘草苷作为抗氧化剂治疗心力衰竭提供了科学依据。
